summary.en: Decisions a person settles: leaders run from 2–3 questions to their answers, an amber bracket closes the chosen answers, a summary box with a note, and the amber stamp lands on beat 5 with a push-in and a thud.
summary.zh: 人拍板的决定：引线从 2–3 个问题连到答案，琥珀色括号框住选定的答案，一个汇总框加一行注，第 5 拍琥珀色印章随镜头推近和一声闷响落下。

fits: A sheet where a person answers what the product will then do: a policy, a review, a sign-off.
notFor: Decisions a machine makes; more than three questions; answers longer than 12 characters.

intent.en: Show the moment a person decides, and certify it: the answers are bracketed in amber and stamped on the beat.
intent.zh: 呈现人做决定的那一刻并加以证明：答案被琥珀色括住，印章踩着拍落下。

content.en: Label, a one-word title, a sub, 2–3 questions (≤ 56) with answers (≤ 12), a round label, a summary (≤ 48), a note, a stamp word and small line.
content.zh: 标签、单词标题、副标题、2–3 个问题（≤ 12 字）和答案（≤ 6 字）、轮次标签、汇总（≤ 20 字）、注、印章词和小字。

fits.zh: 人来回答、产品随后执行的一张图：策略、评审、签字。

notFor.zh: 机器做的决定；超过三个问题；超过 6 字的答案。
